description: This file contains functions for handling requirements data in the TestLink open-source test management system. It includes functions for exporting/importing requirements data in various formats (XML, CSV, DocBook), managing requirement conflicts, linking requirements within scope texts, and analyzing requirement coverage and test case execution status.

methods.name: exportReqDataToXML
methods.description: Exports requirement data to XML format, wrapping provided requirement data in a root element with a template for individual requirement entries.

methods.name: executeImportedReqs
methods.description: Processes an array of imported requirement data, applying conflict resolution strategies such as overwrite or skip, and returns a report array.

methods.name: compareImportedReqs
methods.description: Compares imported requirements with existing ones in the database to identify conflicts or duplicates before import.

methods.name: getReqDocIDs
methods.description: Retrieves a mapping of requirement document IDs associated with a given requirement spec ID.

methods.name: loadImportedReq
methods.description: Loads and parses requirement data from an import file, supporting CSV, XML, and DocBook formats.

methods.name: importReqDataFromCSV
methods.description: Parses CSV file containing requirements into an internal data array for import.

methods.name: importReqDataFromCSVDoors
methods.description: Parses CSV file formatted for Doors requirements management tool into an internal data array.

methods.name: importReqDataFromDocBook
methods.description: Parses requirements encoded in DocBook XML format into internal requirement data structure.

methods.name: doReqImport
methods.description: Performs the actual import process after loading and optional comparison, handling conflict resolution according to parameters.

methods.name: exportReqDataToCSV
methods.description: Exports requirement data array to CSV format for external use or storage.

methods.name: getReqCoverage
methods.description: Analyzes requirement coverage against test cases and execution statuses, returning a detailed coverage report.

methods.name: getLastExecutions
methods.description: Retrieves the latest execution information for a set of test cases within a specific test plan.

methods.name: check_syntax
methods.description: Checks the syntax of an import file based on its type, e.g., CSV or XML.

methods.name: check_syntax_xml
methods.description: Performs a syntax check specifically for XML files, returns a status object.

methods.name: check_syntax_csv
methods.description: Performs a syntax check specifically for CSV files, returns a status object.

methods.name: check_syntax_csv_doors
methods.description: Performs a syntax check for Doors-formatted CSV files, currently unimplemented.

methods.name: req_link_replace
methods.description: Replaces internal tags in requirement scope texts with hyperlinks to linked requirements, supporting different link types (popup, window, frame).
